text: Cortical fsaverage6 acceptance exposed and fixed two native defects: constant-color atlas mip leakage (nearest categorical maximum error 85 before, 0 after) and default orthographic depth clipping dependent on viewport size. Constant UV layouts now update with accounted UV bytes when colors change; default and explicit depth both use compiled projection. Added shared cortical fixture with scalar/sulcal/curvature/nearest/face modes and original-data identity validation; JVM/JS examples passed 15/14. Full conformance now passes 589 tests. Expanded native matrix and 28-case ray-pick/depth regressions running; lit cortical layer at error 4 needs 1831840 triangles and 718087424 accounted bytes, rejecting the earlier 1M-triangle budget.
